QuestInfo.name: Replacement Part
QuestInfo.0: So there is a way to escape from this island? Why does Cutter say it is impossible? Ask him for details.
QuestInfo.1:
Cutter told you that if you can install an Ignition Device on the cannon, then you can #rride the cannon#k to the Nautilus. Ride the cannon...? Sounds strange, but it's worth a try! The Ignition Device was lost on the small island, so swim over and find it!

#i4032985##t4032985#  #b#c4032985#/1#k
QuestInfo.2: You recovered the Ignition Device! It'll take Cutter a while to get it installed, so you have some time to do...something.

0.0: Hey, this Cannon here? Yeah, I built that to escape the island. #rLaunches you all the way back to Victoria Island#k. You'd probably get there alive, too. Just a shame I lost the Ignition Device for it. Now, escape is impossible, it is.\r\n#L0##bWait, time out. Why can't we get the Ignition Device?#l\n#k
0.1: Why? Because it's on the small island! Goodness, child, it's like you don't have ears.\r\n#L0##bRight, but why not go get it from the small island?#l\n#k
0.2: Because I don't know how to swim! Are you even listening to yourself?\r\n#L0##b...But...I can swim.#l\n#k
0.3: (Cutter is silent for a minute.) I have considered this information carefully, and I believe I may, I MAY, have finally formulated a plan to escape this island. Here's the plan. Are you ready? First, you go to the #bsmall island#k and get the #bIgnition Device#k. Second, we escape! How does that sound?

yes.0: Yes... YES! Finally, I can get off this stupid island!

no.0: You cannot be serious. I have devised a perfect, absolutely foolproof plan for getting off this island! Isn't that what you want? Or do you want to stay with the monkey?! I mean...he is a nice monkey, sure...

1.0: Is that... It is. It IS! You brought me the Ignition Device! Ha HA! Okay, let me get this all connected, and we can blast off from this bit of dirt! I'm comin' home, Valerie!

npc.0: Where's the Ignition Device? Haven't you found it yet? It's on the small island! To the right! RIGHT. So, go GET IT.
